name: Long-Baseline Neutrino Facility (LBNF) and Deep Underground Neutrino Experiment (DUNE) Conceptual Design Report Volume 2: The Physics Program for DUNE at LBNF

summary.plain: The first full public description of the physics case for DUNE, written when the project was still called LBNF/DUNE.
summary.technical: LBNF/DUNE CDR Vol. 2 (arXiv:1512.06148, Dec 2015): the physics programme for DUNE at the 1300 km LBNF baseline, predating the 2020 TDR series.
